title: Mom said trading was a waste, then she wanted in
description: Mom finds Nate has spent his savings on tokens and made two dollars, and tells him to quit and focus on school. He grinds on fomo for a month, the chart takes off, Mom ends up trading beside him, and then she finds out he bought more. The hoodie reselling becomes fomo trading; the live-action tag becomes the fomo end line.
text:
SCENE 1 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — DAY
Mom bursts through the door, arms out; Nate sits on his bed with his phone, the wall behind him covered in hand-drawn charts and sticky notes.
MOM: What are all these charts?
MOM: You spent your savings on tokens?
NATE: I'm trading them.
MOM: How much have you made?
Nate glances at his phone, a little sheepish.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the position reads +$2
NATE: Two.
Snap zoom into Mom's glare.
MOM: Exactly. Take them back and focus on school.
NATE: Just give me a month.
Mom, flat and unimpressed. Cut to black.
SCENE 2 — MONTAGE — NATE'S BEDROOM — DAYS AND NIGHTS
Nate's hands fly over his laptop keyboard as he studies the charts.
Nate pins a new hand-drawn chart to the wall, a marker in his teeth.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone, a red day; Nate's thumb hovers over Sell
Nate pulls his thumb back and holds; he drops his head onto the desk.
Late night: Nate's face lit blue by his phone, eyes heavy.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, a small win: the position reads +$40
A tiny fist pump, then straight back to the screen.
Locked off on Nate at his desk as the light flickers day, night, day; he droops lower each time.
Nate slumps back in his chair, staring at the ceiling, drained.
SCENE 3 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
Nate hunched over his phone in the dark; Mom stands in the lit doorway behind him.
MOM: You're still doing this?
NATE: Yeah, because I know I can make it work.
Mom shakes her head and leaves. Nate's phone starts buzzing, again and again.
NATE: Wait...
Extreme close-up: green candles reflected in Nate's eyes; his jaw drops slowly.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the position reads +$1,200
NATE: Yo...
Nate shoots up out of his chair, arms in the air.
NATE: Yeah!
Locked-off time-lapse: Nate trades in fast motion while the room fills with new gear, a new laptop, a lamp, a better chair; the balance on his phone climbs to $4,800, then $18,500. Mom appears in the doorway at normal speed, hands to her face.
MOM: What happened?
NATE: They're all going up. I'm trying...
Day and night jump cuts: Nate at the desk trading in fast motion, the balance reads $62,000; he falls asleep face-down on his laptop.
SCENE 4 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — DAY
Nate jolts awake; Mom walks in, leans over his shoulder and points at his phone.
MOM: What are you doing? You're doing it wrong.
Mom pulls up a chair and they trade side by side, Nate in fast motion, Mom at normal speed.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $310,000
Nate and Mom stand and high five.
NATE: Told ya.
MOM: Don't get cocky.
Fast push in past them to the wall: a fresh row of new hand-drawn charts pinned up to the ceiling. Mom turns to Nate.
MOM: You bought more?
NATE: Huh... maybe.
Whip to Mom's horrified face, saucer eyes.
Nate turns to camera with a small smirk, phone in hand.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $310,000
NATE: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
